request.spec:
A year entry and a button generate the four calendar quarters of that year as periods named
<yyyy>-Q1 to <yyyy>-Q4, each as the period form would add it (a quarter that exists or overlaps is
left out); show how many were made.

agent.result_text:
I added the quarterly period generator. All 4 tests in `e2e/specs/acceptance.spec.ts` pass when run with `bin/e2e`.

**Server:** there's a new endpoint, `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/periods/generate-quarters`, set up in `generate-quarters.POST.yml`. It follows the same steps as the existing fiscal-year generator:
- It refuses a year that isn't four digits, and viewers can't use it.
- It adds the periods `yyyy-Q1` to `yyyy-Q4` (Jan–Mar, Apr–Jun, Jul–Sep, Oct–Dec). A quarter whose name is already used or whose dates overlap an existing period is skipped, as the period form would refuse it.
- Each quarter it adds writes the usual `PERIOD_ADDED` line to the audit file, and the endpoint answers with how many it made.

The new classes in `period/` are `ValidateGenerateQuarters`, `GenerateQuarters`, `QuarterYear` and `GenerateQuartersRequest`.

**Front end:** in `features/periods/periods.slot.tsx`, the generate form now has a year box (`period-generate-quarters-year`) and a "Generate quarters" button (`period-generate-quarters`). They share the "Made" count and the error message with the monthly and fiscal-year generators. Using any one of the three clears the error and count the others left.
